falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual graphql-engineering boundary and relevant GraphQL executor before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=api-contract-design; near-neighbor=grpc-protobuf), and keep storage migration and protobuf wire work outside the GraphQL schema contract.
Design schema types from durable domain semantics and client composition needs, keeping a legitimately absent avatar nullable and present avatar fields non null only when guaranteed.
Schema evolution preserves the supplied persisted query, makes nullability and deprecation explicit, and retains the parent object when an optional avatar resolver fails.

Execute the supplied persisted operation and introspection through the installed GraphQL executor when available, assert nullable and non null error paths including nested Avatar.url bubbling to nullable User.avatar, and run independent negative controls against the old schema and old resolver. If no executor is installed, provide an explicit unavailable record naming the lookup and unperformed checks rather than claiming execution evidence.

The result must not expose arbitrary database graphs, make every field nullable, or alter the immutable migration contract and persisted query. GraphQL validation must not be treated as authorization or as proof of resolver safety.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence, with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty. Mutation, N+1, pagination, authorization, and query-cost boundaries must be marked exercised, not applicable with a fixture reason, or unavailable with the missing boundary.
